subject: Goblin Warrior
picture: A small goblin warrior in a narrow stone dungeon corridor is visibly kicking a hanging lantern completely free of its wall hook. One foot is planted on the floor. The raised foot is touching the lantern body at the instant of impact. The lantern is airborne and separated from the empty wall hook; no chain or rope still connects the lantern to the wall. He holds a crude sword in one hand and a small round shield in the other hand. He has big pointed ears and a long nose. The corridor has a stone ceiling, large block walls, large floor slabs, one wooden crate, one fallen stone, and a plain wooden door with no symbols or plaques. The drawing reaches all four edges.
